B1.note: Built on archived pages only. No network. B1-B5 below is the older umbrella entry and is left as written.

tests/fixtures/swimcloud/team-{412,10002824}-roster-gender-{F,M}-season-form.html (byte-exact slices of the real filter form)
B1.seasonTableTeam412Vs10002824: Identical on all four captured pages (F and M, both teams): 19 seasons, ids 30..12 for 2026-2027..2008-2009, id 29 (2025-2026) selected. Two teams only. This proves nothing about a third, so the API still resolves per team from that team's own page.
B1.rosterUrlShape: ?page=1&gender={M|F}&season_id={id}&sort=name, the roster filter form's own parameter order, matching real recorded URLs such as tests/rosterQueueImport.test.ts.
decisionsForOrchestrator: Queue concurrency default is SWIMMER_TIMES_CONCURRENCY (1), not 3. The brief and the crawl plan say 3 lanes and 400 ms; the code was lowered to 1 lane and 3000 ms on 2026-09-22 after HTTP 429 on 111 of 184 requests.

The swimmer-times endpoint is swimmer-scoped, not season-scoped. The queue key (teamId, seasonId, swimmerId) means one swimmer in two chosen seasons is fetched twice. Open fact 3 (is the endpoint season-filterable) is still unverified.
planTeamSeasonRoster returns SwimCloudTeamSeasonRosterStep, not SwimCloudCrawlStep, because that type requires a meetId and this crawl has none.
